reviewer_scope.frozen_snapshots: Private read-only frozen SQLite snapshots (6); SHA256 bindings in provenance.
reviewer_scope.method: Rebuilt each exported row in memory from the six frozen SQLite snapshots opened with mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON; compared ordered rows exactly. Did not modify package or snapshots, run exporter scripts, access network/APIs, or print source identifiers, exact timestamps, prices, quantities, responses, or balances.
scope_limitations: This validates data payloads and summary metrics against the named frozen snapshots, not the added README or INDEX presentation, staging, or publication; root owns those checks.
It does not establish the exact historical executable version or claim wire-send, exchange-acceptance, first-trade, full-fill, or venue fill timestamps where those clocks are absent.

independent_headline_recomputation.quantile_method: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p with no prior rounding.

limitations: The M0W headline uses its recorded event-receipt anchor. The 31 confirmation-add events use a distinct signal-construction anchor and are excluded from the ordinary headline.

Poly-gap book receipt is locally stamped after the direct Binance Prediction book GET returns; placement wall clocks bracket the client method, while book/place RTT fields use monotonic durations. These rows do not contain actual trade-time stamps.
SUBMITTED is preserved separately from engine fill-evidence flags. No engine status alone is promoted to a universal fill claim.
No output field establishes a venue fill timestamp; all exported book-to-trade and book-to-fill values remain null or explicitly unknown.
